title: Wildly Springy Venezuelan Farfalle Pasta
description: A sour and springy Venezuelan dish featuring farfalle pasta, deep-fry-tod, and low-sodium-friendly ingredients, perfect for a quick fix. This recipe combines the flavors of Venezuela with the convenience of a fast and easy meal.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the farfalle pasta according to the package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat and add the crushed deep-fry-tod.
Cook the deep-fry-tod for 2-3 minutes, stirring frequently, until it is lightly browned.
Add the minced garlic and chopped onion to the skillet and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, stirring frequently.
Stir in the lime juice, chopped cilantro, salt, and black pepper.
Combine the cooked farfalle pasta and the deep-fry-tod mixture in a large bowl.
Toss the pasta and deep-fry-tod mixture together until the pasta is well coated.
Serve the Wildly Springy Venezuelan Farfalle Pasta hot and enjoy.
Garnish with additional chopped cilantro and lime wedges, if desired.
